issues.legal_issue: The bar on questioning the admission of an insufficiently stamped instrument applies only when the court has judicially determined its admissibility.
A court may use its inherent powers to recall the admission and marking of an insufficiently stamped instrument when that admission occurred without judicial determination.
The statutory revision remedy for stamp-related admission decisions does not apply when the court made no determination that the instrument was duly stamped or required no stamp.
A court must examine whether an instrument is duly stamped and impound it if required, regardless of whether a party objects.
